description: MONOTONE 0.3.9 by Trixter of Hornet, a music tracker for the PC speaker, running in your browser with its example songs.
about: MONOTONE is a music tracker for the PC speaker and other simple sound devices by Trixter of Hornet, who wrote it on an IBM PC/XT with CGA. It can also play its songs through an AdLib or the three-voice chip of the Tandy 1000 and IBM PCjr.

It dates from 2008, when an alpha of it came second in the wild competition at Blockparty 2008. This is version 0.3.9, still an alpha, built on 8 July 2017. It comes with its Pascal source and four example songs, among them PRELUDE.MON, a Bach prelude from yesso.
What you save in it stays in this browser: the Files button can download it, bring in MON songs of your own, or start over.
released: Version 0.3.9, built on 8 July 2017. An alpha from 2008 placed second in the wild competition at Blockparty 2008.
credits: Code by Trixter, with changes by Scali in alpha 0.38, its Ctrl+W disk writer among them. Title ANSI by Spinsane of ACiD. Example songs by yesso and virt; virt's RICKROLL.MON is a cover of Rick Astley's “Never Gonna Give You Up”.
terms: The ZIP states none. MONOTONE's repository, github.com/MobyGamer/MONOTONE, whose 0.3.9 release is this ZIP byte for byte, is under the Unlicense: “This is free and unencumbered software released into the public domain.” (LICENSE) It covers MONOTONE itself, not the music its example songs cover.
accuracy: DosKit picks the generic color display, the PC speaker and four tracks in its setup, and goes past its title screen.
Until F2 shows the pattern editor, a song plays behind its still help screen.

Its Ctrl+Shift+P, which plays a song from the beginning, opens a private window in Firefox on Windows and Linux. Ctrl+P, which plays from the cursor's place in the order list, has not been tried here.
Its disk writer is on Ctrl+W, which some browsers keep for closing the tab: DosKit asks before the page closes.
Where its text overlaps on screen, that is MONOTONE's own: it is an alpha.
It has not been compared with real hardware yet.
imageAlt: MONOTONE's pattern editor, running in DosKit
